subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add true soft-steer semantics beyond current boundary steering, and should that be a new opt-in queue mode or a change to existing steer behavior?
rationale: The requested behavior changes when active runs may be interrupted, how partial output and tool results are preserved, and which session context receives injected input; current docs intentionally define boundary steering plus separate interrupt behavior.

options.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Define a new mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume semantics, with tests for streaming, tool execution, transcript state, Codex/embedded harnesses, and fallback behavior.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Close or narrow the product direction and keep remaining work focused on the active-run queue-policy admission path tracked elsewhere.

options.title: Change Steer Globally
options.body: Make existing steer more aggressive by default, accepting compatibility risk for users and tools that rely on current model-boundary behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Define a new mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume semantics, with tests for streaming, tool execution, transcript state, Codex/embedded harnesses, and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed the remaining work as a product/runtime lifecycle decision in the issue discussion.
